New York Herald, 19 June 1866, p. 5, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship China, Captain Hockley, which
left Liverpool at 4 P. M. of the 9th, and Queenstown
on the 10th inst., arrived at Halifax yesterday en route
for Boston. She had one hundred and thirty-seven pas-
sengers for the latter city and thirty-five for Halifax.
The China experienced strong westerly winds and dense
fogs.
The news is three days later.
